import React from "react"; import WorkspacePremiumIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WorkspacePremium'; import SchoolIcon from '@mui/icons-material/School'; import CalendarTodayIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarToday'; import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip'; import '../assets/styles/Education.scss'; const caSkills = [ "Statutory Compliance", "Financial Governance", "Taxation Framework", "Ind-AS / IFRS", "ICFR & Internal Controls", "Auditing & Assurance" ]; const degreeSkills = [ "Financial Accounting", "Corporate Law", "Cost Accounting", "Auditing Principles", "Business Economics", "Financial Management" ]; function Education() { return (

Education & Credentials

Professional qualifications, statutory credentials, and academic foundations

{/* Chartered Accountant Qualification */}
Professional Qualification ICAI Member

Chartered Accountant (CA)

The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

Key Highlights & Competencies
  • Rigorous Statutory Compliance: Comprehensive mastery of corporate governance, statutory audits, and regulatory reporting standards.
  • Financial Governance & ICFR: In-depth expertise across Ind-AS / IFRS financial statements, internal financial controls (ICFR), and risk mitigation frameworks.
  • Advanced Taxation Framework: Extensive practical proficiency in direct and indirect taxation, transfer pricing, and strategic tax planning.
Core Competencies: {caSkills.map((skill, index) => ( ))}
{/* Bachelor's Degree */}
Undergraduate Degree Bachelor's Graduate

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)

University of Delhi

Key Highlights & Honors
  • Financial & Cost Accounting: Rigorous academic foundation in corporate accounting, financial analysis, costing mechanisms, and budgeting.
  • Corporate Law & Governance: Thorough study of mercantile laws, Indian Companies Act regulations, and legal compliances.
  • Economic & Business Analysis: High-honor performance in micro/macroeconomics, business statistics, and auditing methodologies.
Academic Focus: {degreeSkills.map((skill, index) => ( ))}
); } export default Education;
